description:
Seize the opportunity to own this beautiful 3-bedroom condo in the highly desirable Villa Capri Condominiums in NE Phoenix! Step inside to an open, light-filled living space featuring vaulted ceilings, wood-look flooring, and a cozy fireplace—perfect for relaxing nights at home. The bright kitchen offers crisp white cabinetry, built-in appliances, and a two-tier breakfast bar ideal for casual dining or entertaining. The spacious primary suite includes plush carpet, a walk-in closet, and a private en-suite bathroom for comfort and convenience.
Enjoy your morning coffee on the private balcony with extra storage and peaceful neighborhood views. Residents of Villa Capri enjoy resort-style amenities including a community pool and basketball court, plus an unbeatable location.
